description: Change a solid layer's solid (Layer > Solid Settings): name, colour and size, either for every layer that uses the solid (Affect All Layers That Use This Solid) or for these layers only, through a new solid

affectAllLayers.description: Change the solid itself, so every layer using it changes (default true); false gives these layers a new solid

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

name: set_solid_settings
title: Set Solid Settings
